bounded_question: Can the accepted contextual-to-deep inspection grammar operate as an actual transition inside the COMP shell while preserving the selected entity, semantic origin, exact return/focus behavior and state distinctions without becoming a permanent app mode or inventing Product edit semantics?
frozen_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted contextual + deep inspection surface-family grammar
construction_law: Contextual inspection remains subordinate relevant-here capacity reached from a selected meaningful element.
Deep inspection is a deliberate continuation of the same selected entity, not a new permanent application mode.
Deep inspection must name and preserve Production/current-situation/selected-entity origin.
Back and Close return to the same Shaping semantic origin and restore focus to the deep-inspection trigger; neither means Undo.
Selection remains independent from keyboard focus, fictional attention, Director opportunity and Character agency.
Current/historical and provisional/effective distinctions remain textual/structural and hue-independent.
Character identity remains distinct from Performer/provider assignment and disclosure boundaries remain unchanged.
Exact edit, commit, save, validation and undo semantics remain Product-defined and are not invented.
mechanical_acceptance: zero page-level and internal horizontal overflow
zero undersized icon-only controls below 32px reference carrier
deep activation succeeds in both themes from the selected relationship contextual inspector
deep surface preserves exact named origin and selected relationship identity
Back restores Shaping with the same relationship selected and focus returned to the deep-inspection trigger
Close follows the same semantic return contract and does not alter selection or effective state
zero external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: deep inspection must feel like temporary task depth from Shaping, not a second application shell or database editor
the selected relationship identity and origin must remain obvious before and during deep inspection
historical and provisional material must not look current/effective or become color-coded state
dark D3 must preserve inspection-layer separation without turning depth into undifferentiated aubergine
narrow sequential presentation must preserve origin and return without requiring simultaneous columns
durable Home / Productions / Settings chrome must remain visually quieter than the inspection task
explicit_non_goals: final Product entity taxonomy or data schema
Scene lifecycle, Take/Rehearsal/branching or consequence controls
Bellweather placement or bespoke domain icons
production tokens or native WinUI/XAML implementation
result_law: Responsive and interaction-plumbing repairs may change geometry/DOM mechanics only. Any change to the accepted inspection semantics or frozen F2/D3/MAT/TYP/STA/FICON/Stage mechanisms requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-04 retuning.
